records.jp: やー、伶那さんに新体操披露してもらえるなんて<CR>嬉しいな
records.en_original: I can't believe I get to see you do your rhythmic gymnastics routine!
records.en_auxiliary: I can't believe I get to see you do your rhythmic gymnastics routine!
records.en: I cannot believe I get to see you perform rhythmic gymnastics.<CR>I am so happy, Rena-san!

records.jp: まだ私するとか言ってないんだけど
records.en_original: I still haven't agreed to that.
records.en_auxiliary: I still haven't agreed to that.
records.en: I still have not said I would do it.

records.jp: あ、あれ見たい！
records.en_original: Ooh! I wanna see that one thing!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh! I wanna see that one thing!
records.en: Ooh! I wanna see that one thing!

records.jp: ほら、リボンをくるくるってやるやつ。<CR>新体操といえば、って感じの
records.en_original: Y'know, the thing where you spin around with the ribbon. The thing everyone thinks of when they think about rhythmic gymnastics.
records.en_auxiliary: Y'know, the thing where you spin around with the ribbon. The thing everyone thinks of when they think about rhythmic gymnastics.
records.en: You know, the one where you twirl the ribbon around.<CR>The move that comes to mind when you think of rhythmic gymnastics.

records.jp: ローテーションね
records.en_original: You mean rotations?
records.en_auxiliary: You mean rotations?
records.en: A rotation.

records.jp: それそれ！　多分！
records.en_original: Yeah, that! I think.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, that! I think.
records.en: Yeah, that! I think.

records.jp: アチチュード
records.en_original: Attitude!
records.en_auxiliary: Attitude!
records.en: An attitude.

records.jp: まぁ、これしか技名知らないんだけど。<CR>前にテレビで見た時、すごいなって思ったから覚えてて
records.en_original: That's the only technique I really know. I saw it on TV once and thought it looked really pretty.
records.en_auxiliary: That's the only technique I really know. I saw it on TV once and thought it looked really pretty.
records.en: Well, those are the only move names I know.<CR>I remembered them because I thought they looked amazing when I saw them on TV.

records.jp: ふーん……
records.en_original: Huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...
records.en: Huh...

records.jp: そのくらいならしてあげてもいいけど
records.en_original: I suppose I can do that much for you.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose I can do that much for you.
records.en: I suppose I can do that much for you.

records.jp: やったー！
records.en_original: Yay!
records.en_auxiliary: Yay!
records.en: Yay!

records.jp: ちょっとストレッチしてからでいい？
records.en_original: Mind if I start by stretching?
records.en_auxiliary: Mind if I start by stretching?
records.en: Mind if I start by stretching?

records.jp: うん。せっかくだし、私もやってみようかな
records.en_original: Of course! Not every day I get to see this, maybe I'll try them out too!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course! Not every day I get to see this, maybe I'll try them out too!
records.en: Of course! Not every day I get to see this, maybe I'll try them out too!

records.jp: いたたっ！　やばい、つりそう！
records.en_original: Owowowow! Crap, I think I pulled something!
records.en_auxiliary: Owowowow! Crap, I think I pulled something!
records.en: Owowowow! Crap, I think I pulled something!

records.jp: そんなに見られると、やりづらいんだけど
records.en_original: It's distracting when you stare like that, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: It's distracting when you stare like that, you know?
records.en: It's distracting when you stare like that, you know?

records.jp: ごめんごめん、見惚れてた
records.en_original: Sorry, sorry! I couldn't help myself.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, sorry! I couldn't help myself.
records.en: Sorry, sorry! I couldn't help myself.

records.jp: わざとらしい
records.en_original: You're doing that on purpose.
records.en_auxiliary: You're doing that on purpose.
records.en: You're doing that on purpose.

records.jp: さすがだなぁ
records.en_original: Incredible...
records.en_auxiliary: Incredible...
records.en: Incredible...

records.jp: 別にこのくらいなら、ちょっとかじっただけで<CR>誰でもできるようになると思うけど
records.en_original: Anyone can do it with a little practice.
records.en_auxiliary: Anyone can do it with a little practice.
records.en: For something at this level, I think anyone<CR>could learn it after dabbling a little.

records.jp: そう？　詳しくないからわかんないけど、<CR>そういうのって地道な練習の賜物なんじゃないの？
records.en_original: Really? I'm no expert, but isn't that the result of all your hard work?
records.en_auxiliary: Really? I'm no expert, but isn't that the result of all your hard work?
records.en: Really? I'm no expert, but isn't<CR>that the result of all your hard work?

records.jp: コーチがやれって言ったことをやっただけ
records.en_original: I only do what my coach tells me to.
records.en_auxiliary: I only do what my coach tells me to.
records.en: I only did what my coach told me to do.

records.jp: それに従って継続するのも、<CR>中々できることじゃないと思うよ
records.en_original: That may be, but to me it's still amazing!
records.en_auxiliary: That may be, but to me it's still amazing!
records.en: Continuing to follow those instructions<CR>is not something everyone can manage.

records.jp: ってあれ？　伶那さん、顔……
records.en_original: Huh? Rena, your face...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Rena, your face...
records.en: Huh? Rena-san, your face...

records.jp: うっさい。そろそろ黙って
records.en_original: Shut up. Stop it...
records.en_auxiliary: Shut up. Stop it...
records.en: Shut up. Stop it...

records.jp: はいはーい
records.en_original: Yes, ma'am!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, ma'am!
records.en: Yes, ma'am!

records.jp: （にしても私、こんなに固かったっけ。<CR>もうちょっといけたはずなんだけど）
records.en_original: (Was I always this stiff? It feels like I should be able to do better than this.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Was I always this stiff? It feels like I should be able to do better than this.)
records.en: (Was I always this stiff? It feels like I<CR>should be able to do better than this.)

records.jp: （既に痛いけど、<CR>限界まで頑張ろうかな）
records.en_original: (This already hurts... But I think I can go a bit farther if I try...)
records.en_auxiliary: (This already hurts... But I think I can go a bit farther if I try...)
records.en: (This already hurts...<CR>But I think I can go a bit farther if I try...)

records.jp: まずは痛くない範囲で伸ばした方がいい
records.en_original: You shouldn't stretch too far if you aren't used to it.
records.en_auxiliary: You shouldn't stretch too far if you aren't used to it.
records.en: You should start by stretching only within a range that does not hurt.

records.jp: 無理することより、続けることの方が大事だから
records.en_original: It's better to sustain a light stretch than to overextend.
records.en_auxiliary: It's better to sustain a light stretch than to overextend.
records.en: Continuing is more important than pushing yourself too hard.

records.jp: へー、参考にするね
records.en_original: Huh, good to know.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, good to know.
records.en: Huh, good to know.

records.jp: あくまで私の考えだから、保証はしないけど
records.en_original: That's just what I think. No guarantee it's actually true.
records.en_auxiliary: That's just what I think. No guarantee it's actually true.
records.en: That's just what I think. No guarantee it's actually true.

records.jp: この方法が合わなかったら言って。<CR>他の方法教えるから
records.en_original: Let me know if it doesn't work for you. I can show you another method.
records.en_auxiliary: Let me know if it doesn't work for you. I can show you another method.
records.en: Let me know if it doesn't work for you. I can<CR>show you another method.

records.jp: ありがとー、とりあえずやってみるね
records.en_original: Thanks! I'll try this for now.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks! I'll try this for now.
records.en: Thanks! I'll try this for now.

records.jp: 見ててくれてたんだ。<CR>ありがとう、伶那さん
records.en_original: You were watching me? Thanks, Rena.
records.en_auxiliary: You were watching me? Thanks, Rena.
records.en: You were watching me?<CR>Thanks, Rena-san.

records.jp: 私とストレッチしてて怪我したとかなったら、<CR>寝覚め悪いから
records.en_original: I wouldn't be able to sleep at night if you got hurt just from stretching.
records.en_auxiliary: I wouldn't be able to sleep at night if you got hurt just from stretching.
records.en: I wouldn't be able to sleep at night if you got hurt just<CR>from stretching.

records.jp: （照れ隠しなんだろうけど、<CR>寝覚め悪くなるだけでも充分優しいと思う）
records.en_original: (Her tone makes me think it was an insult, but that's actually really sweet...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Her tone makes me think it was an insult, but that's actually really sweet...)
records.en: (She is probably hiding her embarrassment,<CR>but even saying it would bother her conscience is kind enough.)

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
